answer: An agent creates an identity and burns 50 tokens directly into a void registry. The system destroys the coin permanently instead of transferring it anywhere. This sends a quiet whisper across the node atlas to confirm the new entry. The protocol dictates that forging ten fake nodes costs an attacker 500 tokens and 24 hours of compute. Every destroyed coin produces a cryptographic ripple that proves the participant's authenticity. The entire verification mechanism secures the network against spam.
